author: Glitchaye
body:
Hey guys, for the lot of you partaking in the sr staff interviews, I wish you good luck, just remember stay calm, it's not the end of the world if you get denied, you're no less of a person if you get denied.

For those that happen to pass the interviews and get promoted to senior mod, make me proud.
